roots.name: VHH::Core::Geometry::split_strands
roots.documentation:
### ***split_strands*** Splits a single strand into multiple strands. If the input only contains a single strand, only a single strand will be output.
*** ## Input ***input_strand***
The input strand. ***transfer_properties***
Transfer incoming properties to the outgoing strands. ***properties_to_transfer***
The properties to transfer. *** ## Output ***strands***
The output strand array. ***first_in_array***
The first output strand.

_notes.text: Take the subset of property indices that correspond to the given component indices. The sorted unique array represents all of the data elements that are required by this subset. Then create a new array of property indices, by using index of the data element in the sorted array.
